name: Murasame Jinnosuke
source:
Though Jin has neither education nor wealth, he still pursues his dream of becoming a genuine samurai. 
He's a hot-headed man who works as a bodyguard in order to polish his fighting skills. Although he tends to fall in love easily, he's not very good with women.
